name: Dandelion
notes: First colonizer of barren ground. Taproot breaks compaction and mines minerals.

name: Stinging Nettle
food_web_role: N-rich biomass; butterfly host; fermentation base (nettle tea)
notes: Greens-source for N-hot compost tea. Handle with gloves.

name: Yarrow
food_web_role: apex insectary — feeds every beneficial on the farm
notes: Plant in every guild. BD502 biodynamic prep.

name: Broadleaf Plantain
notes: Abundance tells you the ground is compacted. Dig deeper.

name: White Clover
notes: Matrix plant for orchard alleys.

name: Crimson Clover
notes: Winter-seeded, spring-bloomed, chop-and-drop before summer crops.

name: Hairy Vetch
food_web_role: cool-season N-fixer; pairs with rye for no-till rolldown
notes: Part of the classic rye+vetch winter cover.

name: Winter Rye
notes: Rolldown at anthesis for no-till mulch mat.

name: Buckwheat
notes: 30-day to bloom. Stacking insectary.

name: Tillage Radish
notes: Winterkills in zone 6; leaves channels for water + roots.

name: Comfrey (Bocking 14)
food_web_role: THE K source for orchard drip lines; chop 4-6x/yr
notes: Hero permaculture plant. Sterile — won't spread. Regrow cycle is the affordance.

name: Salmonberry
notes: First berry of spring. Pacific NW signature species.

name: Thimbleberry
notes: Soft, delicate fruits. Eat fresh.

name: Highbush Blueberry
notes: Pine-needle + oak-leaf mulch acidifies pH. Pair with sawdust.

name: Red Raspberry
notes: Trellis 2 wires. Prune second-year canes after fruiting.

name: Marionberry
notes: Thornless cultivars exist — prefer for family farms.

name: Strawberry
notes: Renew bed every 4 years via runners.

name: Saskatoon
notes: Thrives where blueberries can't.

name: Apple
food_web_role: canopy guild anchor · cider + storage fruit
notes: Hero tree. 9-state seasonal cycle drives orchard feel.

name: Pear (D'Anjou)
notes: Pick hard, ripen indoors.

name: Pacific Crabapple
food_web_role: native pollinator partner for apple orchard
notes: Plant one per 8 domestic apples to boost pollination.

name: Italian Plum
food_web_role: stone fruit · dried prune · late summer
notes: Self-fertile — great starter stone fruit.

name: Sweet Cherry
food_web_role: early summer stone fruit; bird magnet
notes: Needs pollenizer. Bird netting required at ripening.

name: Hazelnut
notes: Coppice on 7-year rotation for straight poles + nut yield.

name: Sweet Chestnut
notes: Legacy tree. Your kids will harvest.

name: English Walnut
notes: Juglone toxic to solanaceae within 20 m.

name: Pole Bean
notes: Pair with corn trellis + squash ground cover.

name: Snap Pea
notes: Plant early spring + early fall.

name: Flint Corn
notes: Heirloom. Cornmeal + polenta + masa.

name: Winter Squash
notes: Cure 2 weeks; stores 6 months.

name: Russet Potato
notes: Hill with straw as it grows.

name: Carrot
food_web_role: storage root; umbel insectary in year 2
notes: Loose soil or forked roots.

name: Beet
notes: Also feeds livestock (fodder beet).

name: Cabbage
notes: Floating row cover against cabbage moth.

name: Lacinato Kale
notes: Overwinters with mulch.

name: Salanova Lettuce
food_web_role: salad greens; bolting indicator for heat
notes: Succession-plant every 2 weeks.

name: Cherokee Purple Tomato
notes: Indeterminate — trellis tall.

name: Bell Pepper
notes: South-facing wall + row cover speeds ripening.

name: Walla Walla Onion
notes: Cure 2 weeks on mesh; store 4 months.

name: Hardneck Garlic
notes: Plant in autumn for summer harvest.

name: Rosemary
notes: Mulch heavy for winter protection below zone 7.

name: English Lavender
notes: Tight drainage required — avoid waterlogged spots.

name: Watercress
notes: Needs flowing clean water.

name: Quinoa
notes: Rinse saponins before cooking.

name: Western Sword Fern
notes: Forage edge shade canopy.
